name: HWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top title, held by Blade against a promo-only challenge from Malibu Mike Donovan for a Sunday pay-per-view this collection's holdings do not carry past the challenge itself.
notes: Attested by promo claim only, not a results document.

name: HWF Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Bad Ass John, and separately billed to Sir Johnathan in another promo this wing's own holdings do not reconcile.
notes: Attested by promo claim only, not a results document; a rival promo also bills Sir Johnathan as champion, restated as found, not resolved.

name: HWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held by Ken Davidson, challenged for a "Boston Brawl" three weeks out that falls outside this collection's own holdings.
notes: Attested by promo claim only, not a results document.

name: HWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Contended by the Duo of Death and the Odds in a promo billed as "the last stepping stone to a shot at tag team gold"; this collection's own holdings never recover a champion.
notes: GAP REGISTERED: no holder survives in this collection's holdings.
